svg.aria-label: Shadowfax: AI security operations platform for monitoring autonomous AI agents
svg.title: Shadowfax
svg.text: A security operations platform that treats autonomous AI agents as first-class identities.
It gives you visibility, investigation and explainability over what agents actually do, with a
rule-based detection engine, policy management, risk scoring and a live dashboard.
Detection stays deterministic and policy-driven. LLMs explain, correlate and summarise;
they never act as the security boundary.
